kind: automated customer-journey diagnostic; not human usability measurement
method: Actual Chromium upload, stage navigation before initial evaluation, source metadata, finding/duplicate attempt, completion/download, reopening, metadata change, reevaluation and assessment reset. Native empty-uploader callback replay in AppTest failed before/pass after.
before: Pending bytes erased by an empty remounted uploader; completed and reopened exports contained zero original evidence artifacts.

checks: Duplicate action attempted; inspect visible response and exported count
Metadata edit invalidates completion and blocks stale export

limitations: One successful fixed browser journey with two new synthetic TXT files, not a population estimate.
An intermediate replay used the still-running old server module and reproduced the old failure; retained under after/, not counted as testing the loaded correction. Server restarted before fixed/.
No human effort, ROI, independent human TPRM validation, external holdout accuracy or arbitrary interleaving correctness established.
Application as_of uses live server date; these are not frozen holdout cases or pooled benchmark results.
